selectionReasons: effective:ai-cockpit-project-v1:wi1070-a6-task-workspace-timeout: This Work Item rule permits an explicit timeout up to 900 seconds for otherwise admitted task-stage modify_source verification, to allow one complete run of the currently declared cargo test --locked --workspace check. It is a ceiling only: an omitted timeout retains the Runtime's 300-second default. The rule is limited to stage task and does not authorize pre_ci, pr, merge, release, publication, tag, or provider actions. The verification still uses one Runtime worker and the exact declared test command and assertions. Runtime policy binds timeout to operation/stage rather than command digest, so the ceiling applies to otherwise admitted task-stage modify_source verification under this Work Item. single_authorized_human requires actual human approval; this amendment records none.
